findings.problem: This file sits inside a path matched by .claude/rules/emails.md's glob (campaigns/**/emails/*.md), which declares every matching file 'a finished marketing email' that must follow all the formatting rules (Subject:/Preview: lines, single real CTA markdown link, Warmly+sign-off, exact footer). This is instead a compiled working draft of all 9 emails with none of that formatting.
findings.fix: Move this compiled-draft file out of the emails/ folder (e.g. into a sibling drafts/ folder or up one level) so the rule's glob only matches the genuinely finished per-email files.

findings.fix: Relocate out of the emails/ folder so it isn't implicitly held to the finished-email formatting rule.
